name: Yuzuki Celestina
source:
Owning the Magical Heart of "Rubellite" 
She is an impenetrable guardian who protects her master from all disasters.

A loyal maid serving Eris. Rather than being merely a servant, she is like an older sister who
is trusted wholeheartedly. Her personality is elusive and unpredictable, often wearing a subtle smile that gives the impression that she might be the one in control.

She possesses a maternal, voluptuous figure and is known for her nurturing presence. She also has a deep love for novels and stories and is a member of the literature club.
